name: Kickoff & Orientation
description: Meet your cohort, mentors, and the ACS team. Icebreakers, campus tour, and program overview.

name: Design Thinking Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop on Adobe's design thinking methodology. Learn to empathize, define, ideate, prototype, and test.

name: Tech Talk: Scaling at Adobe
description: Senior architects share how Adobe handles billions of API calls daily across Experience Cloud products.

name: First Sprint Reviews
description: Each team presents their first sprint progress. Feedback from mentors and peer teams.

name: Adobe Alchemy Hackathon
description: 24-hour hackathon! Cross-team collaboration, wild ideas, pizza at midnight, and prizes for the most creative solutions.

name: Mid-Program Review
description: Formal mid-point evaluation. Each intern presents progress, learnings, and plans for the remaining weeks.

name: Leader Connect: CTO Session
description: Intimate Q&A session with Adobe's CTO. Career advice, technology vision, and what it takes to build products at scale.

name: Cross-Team Collaboration Sprint
description: Interns swap teams for a week-long collaboration sprint. Work with unfamiliar codebases and new teammates.

name: User Research Field Day
description: Conduct real user interviews and usability tests. Learn research methodologies from Adobe's UX research team.

name: Tech Talk: AI at Adobe
description: Deep dive into Adobe Firefly, Sensei, and the future of AI-powered creative tools.

name: Demo Day
description: The grand finale! Each team presents their project to 200+ attendees including VPs and senior leadership. Awards ceremony follows.

name: Farewell & Retrospective
description: Celebrating 12 incredible weeks. Photo booth, memory wall, farewell speeches, and the ceremonial passing of the ACS torch.
